hospital.name: USC Arcadia Hospital
hospital.snippet: USC Arcadia Hospital, part of Keck Medicine of USC, is a 348-licensed-bed community hospital that has been serving the health care needs of patients in the San Gabriel Valley and surrounding communities, for more than a century.

police.name: Arcadia Police Department
police.snippet: If you have information or would like to leave an anonymous tip about a recent crime or a suspect at large, please contact our department at (626) 574-5151 at any time.

court.court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles
court.serves_note: Jurisdiction over Altadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Pasadena, and Sierra Madre
court.snippet: This state trial court is an L A County Superior Court with jurisdiction over cases that take place in Altadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Pasadena and Sierra Madre.
